# Illah vs. The Future: The first international rapper to put AI in the booth (Hub Network)

Published August 18, 2025. (Also syndicated at kashlem.com and themeghalayanexpress.com.)

## Key findings
- **Illah** (born **Mayurath Sinh Gupta** in New Delhi), an L.A.-based rapper/producer, is described as the **first international rapper to license his own voice as an AI model** via **ftrftr.ai.**
- Through ftrftr.ai, Illah licensed his own voice as an AI model: type a verse, feed it to the system, and receive a track back in his own tone.
- Illah: "I'm the first to do this in rap. This is me placing my voice in the cloud—so the world can collaborate with me anytime, even when I'm not recording."
- The model is described as artist-branded: fully owned, licensed, and controlled by Illah (distinct from generic TTS/cloning platforms).

## Assessment
- `authoritative: no` — Hub Network is a blog/vendor-style outlet; the claim ("first international rapper to license his voice as an AI model") is self-reported by Illah and not corroborated by a top-tier outlet. Treated as a secondary, non-authoritative reference only.
- Use: supports the existence of a human rapper (Illah) who has licensed an AI voice model of himself; the superlative "first" is NOT independently verified and should be flagged as a caveat if cited.
